# PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset 046D:0ABA, long-only collection FF43:0202,
# device index 0xFF. The headset is off when BatterySight starts (its USB
# dongle is plugged in), switched on 45 s later, then off, on and off again.
#
# Real capture: owner capture 2026-11-23, G HUB closed. The trace also held
# the C547 receiver; only this group's frames up to the end of the first
# recorded session are kept, verbatim (the dongle reports the placeholder unit
# id FFFFFFFF, so there is no unit id to replace). The trailing `# +<s>` is the
# frame's time in the capture, counted from app start.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub. Each `in` advances the
# clock by 1 ms; `@t+` lines restore the capture's gaps over 100 ms. The `out`
# lines after an input are the writes that input causes.

# Group arrival: ping index 0xFF; the dongle answers itself (protocol 4.2).
